title: Canal Street New Orleans Traffic 1926 Stereo
blurb: Canal Street, New Orleans Central Business District, view looking back and across from uptown river corner of St. Charles. Scene with automobile, streetcar, and pedestrian traffic. Double mast antennas for WSMB radio seen atop the Maison Blanche Building in background. Not dated, probably 1926 from details and others in series.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.1% vertical error and 0.01° of rotation. Depth measured gentle (0.59% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
